info.title: rust-dns API
info.description:
Management API of the rust-dns authoritative DNS server.

**Authentication.** Either
* a cookie session: `POST /auth/login` (then `/auth/mfa` if MFA is enabled) sets the `rdns_session` cookie, which the browser sends automatically; or
* an API token: `Authorization: Bearer rdns_...` (create one under *Tokens*; use the **Authorize** button).

**CSRF guard.** Cookie-authenticated writes (POST/PUT/DELETE) must send the header `X-Requested-With: rust-dns`, otherwise they fail with 403 `code: csrf`. The Swagger UI in the web console adds this header automatically. Bearer-token requests do not need it.

**Live server.** "Try it out" sends real requests to this server with the caller's permissions: changes are committed, logged and served over DNS immediately.

Errors are JSON `{"error": "...", "code": null|"..."}`. Zones the caller cannot see return 404.

This document is generated from the server's code, so it always matches the running version.

post.description: Checks username and password and starts a cookie session. Depending on the account the session is active at once or still needs a TOTP code (`/auth/mfa`) or forced MFA enrollment (`/auth/enroll`).

200.description: Credentials accepted. Sets the session cookie; check `status` for the next step.

Set-Cookie.description: `rdns_session=...; Path=/; HttpOnly; SameSite=Lax` over plain HTTP; `__Host-rdns_session=...; Path=/; HttpOnly; SameSite=Lax; Secure` over HTTPS (a trusted proxy sent `X-Forwarded-Proto: https`) or with `secure_cookies = true`.

post.summary: Sign in (step 2): TOTP or recovery code
post.description: For a session in `mfa_required` state (cookie from /auth/login). Accepts a 6-digit TOTP code or a one-time recovery code.
For a session in `enroll_required` state: confirm the secret from the login response with a TOTP code.

200.description: Enrolled; session active. Recovery codes are shown once.

get.summary: State of the current cookie session
get.description: Lets a client resume the right sign-in step. Never fails for a missing or expired cookie: that is `anonymous`.

200.description: Session state (`anonymous` without a valid cookie).

post.description: Deletes the cookie session if there is one. Always succeeds.

200.description: Signed out; the cookie is cleared.

get.summary: Current user, client IP and auth method

put.description: Needs an interactive (cookie) session. Not available to root, whose password is set in the configuration file. Every other session of the user is signed out; API tokens keep working (revoke them separately).

post.description: Needs an interactive (cookie) session. Replacing an already enrolled authenticator also needs the current TOTP code or the password.

requestBody.description: Only when MFA is already enrolled (replacing the authenticator): the current TOTP `code` or the account `password`. Otherwise send no body or `{}`.

200.description: Secret, otpauth URI and QR SVG; confirm with /me/mfa/confirm.

post.description: Confirms the secret from /me/mfa/start with a TOTP code.
Not allowed when MFA is required for the account. Needs a current TOTP code.
Needs a current TOTP code; the previous recovery codes stop working.

200.description: New recovery codes (old ones stop working).

post.description: Needs an interactive (cookie) session; keeps the current one.
Needs `create_zones`. The owner defaults to the caller.

get.summary: Zone with the first page of records and its members

put.description: Needs the owner role; changing `owner` needs `transfer_ownership` (administrators). Omitted fields are unchanged.

delete.summary: Delete a zone and all its records

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Search text matched against name, type and value.

post.description: Needs the editor role. To register a name that disappears unless renewed, send `expires_in` (seconds) or `expires_at`; posting the identical record again with a new expiry renews it (200).

expiring.summary: Self-registration: A record that expires in 24 hours unless renewed

200.description: Renewed: an identical record (same name, type and value) already existed and the request carried an expiry, or the existing one had expired. Its expiry was replaced.

put.description: Needs the editor role. Send only the fields you change: omitted fields, including `ttl`, keep their current values. Send `"ttl": null` to switch to the zone default TTL.
Needs the owner role on the zone.

delete.description: Needs the owner role on the zone.

get.summary: Effective rights of a user or of their API tokens
get.description: Administrators may read anyone's; users their own.

parameters.name: via
parameters.description: `token` shows what the user's API tokens may do.

200.description: Rights generated from the same permission table the API enforces.

get.summary: Export all visible zones as JSON

post.description: Callers with `create_zones` may create zones; others can only import into zones where they are owner.

parameters.name: mode
parameters.description:
`merge` adds missing zones and records; `replace` replaces the records
of each zone in the document.

get.description: One row per committed fact (zone, record, serial, member); rows from one transaction share `txn` and `command`. Rolled-back operations never appear. Non-admins see only their zones; membership rows and other users' `actor_ip` (empty string) only on zones they own.

parameters.name: after
parameters.description:
Return entries after this offset/id (oldest first). Omit for the most
recent entries.

get.description: Users, MFA, recovery codes, sessions, API tokens, root sync. Each entry was written in the same transaction as the change. Needs `view_audit`.

parameters.name: after
parameters.description:
Return entries after this offset/id (oldest first). Omit for the most
recent entries.

get.summary: WebSocket stream (not callable from Swagger UI)
get.description:
WebSocket upgrade; Swagger UI cannot open it, use a WebSocket client. Streams change events (resumable with `after`) and, with `queries=true`, live DNS queries for zones the caller owns.

Browsers authenticate with the session cookie; the page's `Origin` must match the host. Other clients send an API token as a subprotocol: `Sec-WebSocket-Protocol: rust-dns, rust-dns.bearer.<token>` (the server selects `rust-dns`), e.g. `websocat --protocol 'rust-dns, rust-dns.bearer.rdns_...' ws://host/api/ws?after=0`. `?token=` still works but is deprecated: URLs end up in proxy logs.

The stream re-checks the credentials and zone rights every 10 seconds and on membership changes; when the session or token is revoked or the account is disabled it closes with code 1008.

parameters.name: after
parameters.description: Replay change events after this offset first (WAL-style cursor).

parameters.name: token
parameters.description: Deprecated: API token in the URL (ends up in logs). Use the `rust-dns.bearer.<token>` subprotocol.

101.description: Switching protocols. Text frames are JSON: `{"type":"hello",...}`, `{"type":"change","event":ChangeEvent}`, `{"type":"query","event":QueryEvent}`, `{"type":"resync","head":N}` (see the ChangeEvent and QueryEvent schemas).

put.description: All fields optional. Changing the password or disabling the account signs the user out everywhere.

post.summary: Reset a user's MFA and sign them out (admin)

get.description: Active tokens with their tags, last use time and last client IP. Filter with `tag` (exact, case-sensitive match).

parameters.name: tag
parameters.description: Only tokens carrying exactly this tag (case-sensitive, surrounding spaces ignored).

200.description: Tokens (own, or everyone's with `all=true` for admins).

post.description: The token acts with exactly the caller's rights. Tokens do not expire; revoke them when no longer needed. Optional `tags` label the token (change them later with `PUT /tokens/{id}`).

201.description: Created. The plaintext token is returned only once.

put.description: Replaces the tag list. Own tokens; administrators (`manage_users`) may update anyone's. Revoked tokens cannot be changed (404). A change is recorded in the audit log as `token.update` with the tags before and after.

delete.description: Own tokens; administrators may revoke anyone's.

get.description: Cheap database ping (no integrity scan). No authentication.
Generated from the server's route and type definitions, so it always matches the running server.

get.summary: Server status, counters and runtime settings

post.description: Re-reads the configuration file and applies runtime settings. Needs `server_admin`.

get.description: Runs `PRAGMA quick_check` over the whole database; may be slow on large databases. Needs `server_admin`.

Upstream resolvers, allowed client networks and timeout currently in effect, whether they come from the config file or were saved from the console, and the config file's own values. Needs `server_admin`.

put.description: Saves forwarding settings that override `[forwarding]` in the config file and applies them at once (no restart). The change and its audit entry are one transaction. Needs `server_admin`.

delete.summary: Use the config file's forwarding settings again (admin)
delete.description: Removes the console override; `[forwarding]` from the config file applies at once. No-op when there is no override. Needs `server_admin`.

post.description: Sends a recursive `. NS` query to each upstream over UDP and reports whether and how fast it answered. Nothing is saved. Needs `server_admin`.

200.description: One result per upstream, in order.

post.description: Drops every cached forwarded answer; the next queries go to the upstreams. Audited as `settings.forwarding.cache_flush`. Needs `server_admin`.

get.description: Names, algorithms and zone scopes. Secrets are never listed. Needs `server_admin`.

post.description: Generates a random secret, or imports `secret` (base64) when the secondary provider generated the key. The secret is returned only in this response (later: `POST /tsig/keys/{name}/reveal`, audited). Recorded in the audit log as `tsig.create` without the secret. Takes effect at once. Needs `server_admin`.

generate.summary: Generate a secret, key limited to one zone

import.summary: Import a secret from the secondary provider, all zones

201.description: Created. The secret is shown only here.

put.summary: Change the zones a TSIG key may transfer (admin)
put.description: Replaces the zone scope; an empty list allows every zone. The secret and algorithm cannot be changed (create a new key and delete the old one). Recorded as `tsig.update`. Needs `server_admin`.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Key name, with or without the trailing dot (`hn-secondary.`).

delete.description: Secondaries using it can no longer transfer; NOTIFY configured with it is no longer sent. Recorded as `tsig.delete`. Needs `server_admin`.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Key name, with or without the trailing dot (`hn-secondary.`).

post.summary: Show a TSIG key's secret (admin, audited)
post.description: Returns the base64 secret, e.g. to configure another secondary. Every call is recorded in the audit log as `tsig.reveal` (without the secret). Needs `server_admin`.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Key name, with or without the trailing dot (`hn-secondary.`).

get.description: Allowed networks, whether TSIG is required, and NOTIFY targets with their keys, from `[transfer]` in the config file (edit the file and reload to change them). Needs `server_admin`.
Mounted at the server root (`/metrics`), not under `/api`. Requires authentication (a bearer API token for scrapers).

text/plain.example:
# HELP rustdns_queries_total DNS queries received
# TYPE rustdns_queries_total counter
rustdns_queries_total 0

AuditRecord.description: A committed audit row, as stored and returned by the API.

txn.description: Shared by every row written in the same transaction.

ChangeEvent.description: One changelog entry; also the event broadcast after every mutation.

payload.description:
The exact committed fact, tagged by `kind`: zone_created, zone_updated,
zone_deleted, record_created, record_updated, record_deleted,
serial_bumped, member_set, member_removed.

txn.description: Shared by every row committed in the same transaction.

command.description: Operation that produced the change (create_record, import, ...).

ChangelogPage.description: Change log entries plus retention bounds.

resync_required.description: `after` fell behind retention; refetch full state.

code.description: 6-digit TOTP code (or, for /auth/mfa, a recovery code).

forwarded.description: Answers forwarded to an upstream resolver.

cache_hits.description: Forwarded answers served from the cache.

bad_cookie.description: Requests with an invalid or malformed DNS cookie.

tsig_errors.description: Signed requests rejected (unknown key, bad signature, clock skew, truncated MAC).

qr_svg.description: SVG QR code of `otpauth_uri` (null if it could not be rendered).

Error.description: Every non-2xx JSON error has this shape.

oneOf.description:
Machine-readable reason when one applies: `login_required`,
`mfa_required`, `enroll_required` (401) or `csrf` (403, cookie write
without `X-Requested-With: rust-dns`). `invalid_request`: the request
could not be parsed (malformed JSON, wrong field type or value,
unparsable path or query parameter, missing JSON content type).

ErrorCode.description: Machine-readable reason carried by some errors.

ExportRecord.description:
One record of an export document; `ttl: null` (or omitted) means the
zone default.

expires_at.description: Exported expiry. Records already expired at import time are skipped.

ExportZone.description:
One zone of an export document. On import, omitted SOA fields fall back
to the server defaults (new zones) or are left unchanged.

ForwardCacheInfo.description: Forwarding cache size and counters since start.

hit_rate.description: hits / (hits + misses); 0 when there were no lookups.

ForwardingFileValues.description: Forwarding values from the config file (shown next to an override).

ForwardingInput.description:
New forwarding settings. Upstreams are IP addresses with an optional port
(53 when omitted): `1.1.1.1`, `8.8.8.8:53`, `2606:4700:4700::1111`,
`[2001:4860:4860::8888]:53`. Host names are not accepted.

upstreams.description: At most 8, tried in order. An empty list turns forwarding off.

allowed_clients.description:
CIDR networks or single addresses. Anything that would make this an
open resolver is refused: an entry shorter than /8 (IPv4) or /16
(global IPv6), or entries covering over 1/16 of IPv4 together.

cache_max_ttl.description:
Cap on how long positive answers are cached, 1 to 604800 seconds.
Omitted: the config file's `cache_max_ttl`.

cache_negative_max_ttl.description:
Cap on how long negative answers are cached, 1 to 604800 seconds and
not above the positive cap. Omitted: the config file's value.

upstreams.description: Upstream resolvers in effect, `ip:port`, tried in order. Empty: foreign names are refused.

allowed_clients.description: Client networks allowed to use forwarding.

updated_by.description: Who saved the override (`null` when the config file applies).

updated_at.description: When the override was saved (`null` when the config file applies).

cache_max_ttl.description: Longest a positive answer is cached, seconds (in effect).

cache_negative_max_ttl.description: Longest a negative answer is cached, seconds (in effect).

config.description: The config file's values, for comparison and reset.

GlobalPerm.description: Something a caller may do outside any one zone.

GlobalRight.description: One account-level permission and whether the user holds it.

status.description:
`ok`: signed in. `mfa_required`: POST /auth/mfa next.
`enroll_required`: scan `enroll` and POST /auth/enroll.

oneOf.description: TOTP enrollment data; non-null only when `status` is `enroll_required`.

LoginStatus.description: Next step after the password was accepted.

Member.description: A user granted access to a zone that is not its owner.

MemberRole.description: Role of a zone member (the owner is not a member).

used_recovery_code.description: True when a one-time recovery code (not a TOTP code) was used.

NotifyTargetView.description: One NOTIFY target from the config file.

key.description: Key that signs NOTIFY to this target; `null`: unsigned.

key_exists.description: False when `key` names a key that does not exist (then no NOTIFY is sent).

QueryEvent.description: Emitted for every DNS query the server answers (streamed over `/ws`).

result.description:
What was returned, one entry per answer record in presentation form
("A 192.0.2.10", "CNAME www.example.com."), plus notes for referrals
and truncation. Capped in length; empty for negative answers.

ReauthBody.description: Body of `POST /me/mfa/start` when replacing an enrolled authenticator.

code.description: A current TOTP code of the enrolled authenticator.

Record.description:
A record as stored. `name` is relative to the zone: `@` for the apex,
`www`, `*`, `_sip._tcp` and so on.

value.description: Presentation format, e.g. `10 mail.example.com.` for MX.

ttl.description: The record's TTL; `null` means the zone default TTL applies.

expires_at.description:
When the record stops being served (RFC 3339, UTC); `null` = never.
Expired records stay visible in the console and are deleted after
`[expiry].retention_days` (default 30).

RecordInput.description:
Input for creating or updating a record. Create: `type` is required,
`name` defaults to `@`. Update: omitted fields keep their current values,
including `ttl`; `"ttl": null` switches to the zone default.

ttl.description:
Omitted: keep the current TTL (update) or use the zone default (create).
`null`: zone default. A number: that TTL.

expires_at.description:
When the record stops being served, RFC 3339 (e.g. "2026-10-01T00:00:00Z").
Absent: keep the current expiry (update) or never expire (create).
`null`: never expire. Must be in the future. Do not combine with
`expires_in`.

RecordType.description: Record types the server stores and serves.

recovery_codes.description: Shown once; the previous codes stop working.

notes.description: What changed / what needs a restart.

Rights.description: Effective rights of a user (or of their API tokens).

zone_permissions.description: Legend: every zone permission and the minimum role it needs.

RoleSource.description: Where a zone role comes from.

ServerStatus.description: Server status, counters and runtime settings.

nsid.description: EDNS NSID reply; empty when off.

catalog_built_at.description: When the in-memory zone catalog was last rebuilt.

current.description: True for the session making this request (always false in the admin view).

oneOf.description: TOTP enrollment data; non-null only when `status` is `enroll_required`.

SettingSource.description: Where the forwarding settings in effect come from.

StatusResponse.description: Acknowledgement of an action without further data.

tags.description:
Optional labels: at most 16, each 1-256 characters of `[A-Za-z0-9_-]`
after trimming (case is kept); duplicates are dropped.

token.description:
Plaintext `rdns_...` token; shown only once. Send as
`Authorization: Bearer <token>`.

TokenInfo.description: An API token (never includes the secret).

tags.description:
Labels for finding and grouping tokens (`[A-Za-z0-9_-]`, case kept,
1-256 characters each, at most 16, sorted and de-duplicated).

last_used_at.description:
Last successful authentication with this token. Refreshed at most once
a minute (immediately when the client IP changes), so it may lag
real use by up to 60 seconds. `null`: never used.

last_used_ip.description:
Client IP of the last successful authentication (after trusted-proxy
resolution). `null`: never used.

tags.description:
The complete new tag list (replaces the old one; `[]` clears it).
At most 16, each 1-256 characters of `[A-Za-z0-9_-]` after trimming
(case is kept); duplicates are dropped.

TransferSettingsView.description:
The zone transfer policy in effect (`[transfer]` in the config file;
change it there and reload).

allow.description: Client networks allowed to request transfers. Empty: transfers disabled.

require_tsig.description: Transfers also need a valid TSIG signature.

port.description: DNS port this server listens on (for secondary configuration snippets).

warnings.description: Problems with the settings in effect, e.g. a NOTIFY key that does not exist.

require_tsig.description: Transfers also need a valid TSIG signature (`[transfer].require_tsig`).

TsigAlgorithm.description:
HMAC algorithm of a TSIG key. `hmac-sha1` is legacy: only for secondaries
that support nothing better.

TsigKeyCreated.description:
The created key and its secret. The secret is shown only here; later use
`POST /tsig/keys/{name}/reveal` (audited).

secret.description: Base64 secret, for the secondary's configuration.

name.description:
Key name: a DNS name, lowercase with a trailing dot. Secondaries must
use exactly this name.

zones.description: Zones this key may transfer. Empty: every zone.

TsigKeyInput.description:
A new TSIG key. Without `secret` a random one is generated (as long as
the hash: 32 bytes for hmac-sha256); with `secret` the base64 value your
secondary provider gave you is imported.

name.description: A DNS name such as `hn-secondary.` (a trailing dot is added; stored lowercase).

secret.description: Base64 secret to import (16 to 512 bytes). Omit to generate one.

zones.description: Zones this key may transfer. Omitted or empty: every zone.

TsigKeyZones.description: New zone scope of a key.

zones.description: Zones this key may transfer. Empty: every zone.

ok.description: True when the upstream answered a recursive query for `. NS`.

ms.description: Round-trip time in milliseconds when it answered.

rcode.description: Response code when it answered, e.g. "No Error".

User.description: A user account as the API shows it (no secrets).

mfa_required.description: The user must enroll a TOTP authenticator at the next sign-in.

UserBody.description:
Create: `username` and `password` (min. 8 characters) are required.
Update: every field is optional; setting `password` or `disabled: true`
signs the user out everywhere. The root account's password is managed in
the config file.

mfa_required.description: The user must enroll a TOTP authenticator at the next sign-in.

UserWithRecoveryCodes.description: A user plus freshly generated recovery codes.

ip.description: Client IP as resolved by the server (proxy aware).

Zone.description: A zone as stored. Names are stored lower-case without the trailing dot.

name.description: Lower-case, no trailing dot (`.` for the root zone).

serial.description: SOA serial (unsigned 32-bit, so it may exceed the int32 range).

records.description: First page of records (use /zones/{zone}/records to page or search).

members.description: Empty unless the caller may manage access (owner).

ZoneDetail.description: A zone with the first page of records and its members.

ZoneInput.description:
Input for creating or updating a zone. Create: `name` is required, other
fields fall back to server defaults. Update: omitted fields are left
unchanged (`name` is ignored).

owner.description:
Owner username. Create: defaults to the caller. Update: administrators
only; empty string clears the owner.

ZonePerm.description:
Something a caller may do inside one zone. Granted when the caller's role
on the zone is at least [`ZonePerm::min_role`].

ZoneRights.description: The user's role on one zone and what it allows.

ZoneRole.description: What a caller may do with a zone.

role.description: The caller's role on this zone.

ZoneView.description: A zone with the caller's view of it.

BadRequest.description: Invalid input: rejected by validation, or the request could not be parsed (`code: invalid_request`).

Forbidden.description: Not allowed, or cookie write without `X-Requested-With: rust-dns` (`code`: csrf).

InvalidRequest.description: Invalid request: malformed JSON, wrong field type or value, or an unparsable path or query parameter (`code: invalid_request`).

NotFound.description: Not found (zones the caller cannot see also return 404).

ServiceUnavailable.description: Too many password checks are running at once (they are CPU-bound and deliberately limited so DNS stays fast). Retry after `Retry-After` seconds.

example.error: too many sign-ins or password changes in progress; retry in a moment

TooManyRequests.description: Too many attempts: the per-client rate limit (an IPv4 address or IPv6 /64), the account's failed-attempt back-off, or the session's code-attempt limit. `Retry-After` says when to try again.

example.error: too many failed attempts for this account; try again in 4 seconds

Unauthorized.description: Not signed in / invalid token (`code`: login_required, mfa_required, enroll_required).

cookie.name: rdns_session
cookie.description: Session cookie set by POST /auth/login (named `__Host-rdns_session` over HTTPS). Cookie writes also need `X-Requested-With: rust-dns`.
